pages.text:
Pumps the fluid source block directly below it: a bucket every second for 10 FE/t. It pushes up to 1,000 mB/t out of its top.
It removes the source it pumps, except water that refills itself (two or more water sources beside it), which it leaves in place: an endless water supply for boilers.
On water in an ocean or beach biome it pumps Seawater instead, for the Thermal Evaporator Array.
